prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ buildCollectionView }`.

`buildCollectionView(title, records)` produces a framework-neutral view model. `title` must be a string and `records` must be an array; otherwise throw `TypeError`. Every record must be a non-array object with a string `id`, string `label`, and finite numeric `rank`. Record IDs must be nonempty and unique. Reject malformed records with `TypeError` and duplicate IDs with `RangeError`.

Return `{ heading, count, items }`, where:
- `heading` is `title.trim()`.
- `count` is the number of records.
- `items` contains newly allocated objects `{ id, label, rank }`.
- Items are ordered by ascending `rank`, then ascending `label` by code-unit comparison, then ascending `id`.
- An empty array is valid and produces an empty `items` array.

The function must not reorder or otherwise mutate `records` or its objects. Later changes to the input array or its records must not affect the returned view model.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
